ns2:section.sectionText: This course section is open only to admitted NRES MS online degree-seeking students This section is a self-paced orientation course to the NRES MS program. The instructor will contact enrolled students via email or phone and provide them with course access instructions. This is not a joint offering with any other program.Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see https://online.illinois.edu. This section is restricted to 1st-time Grad students. As per Board of Trustees approval, the $-205 Tuition reduction only applies to students in the MS: Nat Res Env Sci Online Program (10KS0190MSU) admitted before Fall 2016.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $614.00 per Bill Hour, OCE Tuition $-205.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
